details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K5 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K6 (segment and geographic revenue distribution) is MISSING - no breakdown of SAF products vs other products or export percentages is provided. K7 (loss explanation and outlook) is MISSING - while management mentions stabilization, there is no explicit characterization of the loss as temporary or focus on strategic niches. K8 (proposal to cover loss) is MISSING - no mention of using retained earnings to cover the loss. The summary captures most financial performance and operational details but omits key strategic context and loss coverage proposal, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of improved profitability despite revenue decline. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. The summary flows logically from revenue performance to profitability metrics, cash flow, investments, and concludes with auditor opinion. While there is a minor arithmetic relationship between segment revenues and consolidated revenue (S2-S5), the candidate does not claim these are exhaustive additive components of the same total, so this does not constitute a contradiction per evaluation guidelines. Repetition is minimal and does not materially reduce clarity.
